violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Observed employee leave kitchen area to do other task, return to remove cooked chicken from fryer area with bare hands that were not washed.
Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed handling ready-to-eat food with bare hands. Observed employee plating food with bare hands.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Soap and water used for cleaning. No sanitizer being used to clean tables after each use.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Observed floors, walls and ceiling with buildup of debris.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not properly protected from potential contamination. Open container of hashbrowns stored under flat of eggs.--Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Turkeys and other food items stored on floor in freezer.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Ceiling in kitchen area is made of wood. Not smooth, cleanable surface.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Attachments to walls and ceilings (e.g. light fixtures, vent covers, decorations etc..)* were not cleanable and/or maintained in good repair. Light fixtures have wires hanging down.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Ceilings and walls need to be cleaned.

Lighting. — --Lighting did not have protective shielding in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, or unwrapped single-service items . Light fixture in kitchen area did not have a light shield.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Unapproved poison or toxic material was observed in food establishment. Several containers of insect control were stored in kitchen area above working food area.
